description: List the books in a specific Bible translation (e.g. KJV → 66 books). Returns book IDs and chapter counts needed for bible.passage. Free Use Bible API

translation.description: Bible translation ID (e.g. "KJV", "ASV", "WEB", "BSB"). Use bible.translations to discover IDs.
